_notes.password.hint: The English, Polish and Arabic password.hint still say the same salt on the server is needed to import; the salt was removed (JEMP v3 is password-only). Proposed English: "The password is the encryption key of the package. The same password is needed to import it again." The translations here already follow the corrected text.
